lines.text: Isaiah son of Amoz receives a message about Judah and Jerusalem, and the LORD's mountain will be raised above the hills.
Many peoples will go up to the mountain of the LORD to be taught His ways, and they will beat swords into plowshares.
The LORD has abandoned the house of Jacob because they are filled with influences from the south and are soothsayers like the Philistines.
The Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud, including the cedars of Lebanon and the oaks of Bashan.
On that day men will cast away their idols of silver and gold to the moles and bats.
